Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring initiatives and referenda to set forth repealed language in full.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing statutes; and adding a new section tochapter 29A.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An initiative or referendum that repeals a statute shall set forththe language being repealed in its entirety. Statutes repealed inviolation of this section presumptively violate Article II, section 37of the Washington state Constitution.
